name: MixedSwapRouter forged-pool swap callback payer
summary: MixedSwapRouter accepted any caller-listed contract exposing fee(), token0() and token1() as a V3 pool, and its algebraSwapCallback trusted the callback data the pool passed back, checking only that msg.sender equalled the pool named in that data. From a contract constructor (which skips the router's contract whitelist), the attacker swapped through its own fake pool, whose callback named a user who had approved the router as payer, so the router transferred 293,182 WINR from that user to the fake pool.
notes: The router proxy has run implementations with the same callback since earlier upgrades (e.g. 0x0e752bd4); the age is taken from the upgrade to 0x58637aaa that the anchor executed (rule 7). Campaign scan from that upgrade finds no other exercise; earlier implementations were not scanned.
WINR is valued at DefiLlama's price; the attacker sold 240,716 WINR over the next days at about the same rate (e.g. 116,591 WINR for 6,061.75 USDT in 0x09182eb8).
